description: This file defines the AOW_WorkFlowController class, which manages various AJAX actions related to workflow modules in SuiteCRM, including retrieving module fields, relationships, operators, and executing workflow actions.

classes.name: AOW_WorkFlowController
classes.description: Controller class handling AJAX requests for workflow module operations in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_getModuleFields
methods.description: Retrieves module fields based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_getRelatedModule
methods.description: Returns the related module name for a given module and relationship field.

methods.name: action_getModuleRelationships
methods.description: Fetches relationships for a specified module.

methods.name: action_getModuleOperatorField
methods.description: Gets operator options for a module field based on its type.

methods.name: action_getFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides field type options for a module field.

methods.name: action_getModuleFieldType
methods.description: Retrieves module field type options based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_getModuleFieldTypeSet
methods.description: Sets module field type options based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_getRelFieldTypeSet
methods.description: Sets related module field type options.

methods.name: action_getRelActionFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for related action field types.
